mapper.sql: SELECT remind_id, remind_type, related_id, related_name, remind_content, expire_date, remind_days, remind_status, notify_level, to_person_id, to_person_name, read_time, handle_by, handle_time, handle_result, enterprise_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_safety_remind
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_safety_remind WHERE del_flag = '0' AND remind_status = #{remindStatus}
SELECT remind_type as remindType, COUNT(1) as count FROM biz_safety_remind WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY remind_type

SELECT remind_id as remindId, remind_type as remindType, related_name as relatedName, remind_content as remindContent, expire_date as expireDate, remind_status as remindStatus, to_person_name as toPersonName FROM biz_safety_remind WHERE del_flag = '0' AND remind_status IN ('0', '1') ORDER BY expire_date ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_safety_remind SET del_flag = '2' WHERE remind_id = #{remindId}
UPDATE biz_safety_remind SET del_flag = '2' WHERE remind_id IN #{remindId}
